depends_on: Allouche-Peyriere-Wen-Wen 1998 Prop. 2.2 (Hankel determinants of the period-doubling sequence are odd)
notes: a(n)>0: A086618(n) are the moments of the image of Marchenko-Pastur x uniform angle under 1+t+2sqrt(t)cos(theta), a measure with infinite support, so the Hankel (Gram) determinants are positive. a(n) odd: A086618 mod 2 is the period-doubling sequence (Lucas plus Catalan parity), whose Hankel determinants are odd by APWW Prop. 2.2. Not 7 mod 8: verified n<=300, open. Lean status: APWW Prop. 2.2 and the Gram-determinant positivity for moment sequences are not formalised. Outside Lean: the whole argument (moment representation, Gram positivity, APWW citation) and the mod-8 computation.
